# InteractiveBrowserCredentialProvider

- Namespace/type: `PPDS.Auth.Credentials.InteractiveBrowserCredentialProvider`
- Assembly: `PPDS.Auth`

## Summary

Provides authentication using interactive browser flow. Automatically opens the system browser for user sign-in.

#### .ctor

```text
public System.Void .ctor(PPDS.Auth.Cloud.CloudEnvironment cloud = 0, System.String tenantId = default, System.String username = default, System.String homeAccountId = default, System.Action`1<PPDS.Auth.Credentials.DeviceCodeInfo> deviceCodeCallback = default, System.Func`2<System.Action`1<PPDS.Auth.Credentials.DeviceCodeInfo>,PPDS.Auth.Credentials.PreAuthDialogResult> beforeInteractiveAuth = default)
```

Creates a new interactive browser credential provider.

- Parameter `cloud`: The cloud environment.
- Parameter `tenantId`: Optional tenant ID (defaults to &quot;organizations&quot; for multi-tenant).
- Parameter `username`: Optional username for silent auth lookup.
- Parameter `homeAccountId`: Optional MSAL home account identifier for precise account lookup.
- Parameter `deviceCodeCallback`: Optional callback for device code display (used for device code fallback).
- Parameter `beforeInteractiveAuth`: Optional callback invoked before opening browser for auth. Returns the user&#x27;s choice (OpenBrowser, UseDeviceCode, or Cancel). The callback receives a device code callback to use if device code is selected.

Returns: A new provider instance.
